audio.text: I can't find my student ID card anywhere.

options: The bus was late again this morning, unfortunately.
Anywhere is fine with me, really.
I found the library much quieter than usual today.
Have you checked the pockets of your jacket?

why.en: Problem → a helpful suggestion. B repeats "anywhere" as if a choice had been offered; C uses "found" in a different sense; A changes the subject.
why.tr: Sorun → yardımcı bir öneri. B "anywhere" kelimesini sanki bir seçenek sunulmuş gibi tekrar ediyor; C "found" kelimesini başka anlamda kullanıyor; A konuyu değiştiriyor.
why.es: Problema → una sugerencia útil. B repite "anywhere" como si le hubieran ofrecido elegir; C usa "found" con otro sentido; A cambia de tema.
